Great for a chill excellent staff
Jan 2026 • Family
Found this gem of a restaurant by chance the entrance is hard to spot it is off the main road, look for a blue sign with the name and you walk down a narrow steep path to the restaurant/hotel right on the sea with beautiful views Great for sunsets
The menu hasn't got a lot of choice but it had steak and chicken breast for a fussy eater like me and pasta and Vietnamese food also but you can just go there for drinks and look at the menu for next time
A big shout out to Lulu the waitress she is so happy and friendly and very good with people 
I would say this was one of our favourite restaurants in Vietnam during our four week stay
Would I go back again ? If we was in Vietnam yes definitely John
